steps.name: Blend the misty sky over the whole canvas

lines.text: Inside the outlined area. It reaches all four edges of the canvas.
Paints, top to bottom: Pale gold, Blue-violet mist, then Misty blue.
Mix enough Pale gold for this step and steps 11 and 20; cover it between them.
Mix enough Blue-violet mist for this step and steps 3 and 6; cover it between them.
Mix enough Misty blue for this step and step 4; cover it between them.
Brush: 1 1/2 inch flat. Load: Creamy paint. An even coat.
Start with the darkest color and stroke side to side. Without rinsing, pick up the next lighter color and paint below it. Then stroke back up over the join several times.
It should leave smooth bands of color, with a soft join where two wet colors meet.
Watch out: Blending after the paint has started to drag. Acrylic sets in minutes, and scrubbing setting paint lifts it and leaves streaks. Fix: stop as soon as it drags.
Let it dry, then blend a new thin layer on top.

steps.meant: The whole canvas is a soft haze: pale gold glowing in the upper left, misty blue across the middle, blue-violet on the right and low down. No sun disk, trees, ground or leaves yet.

steps.name: Circle in the glowing sun

lines.text: Let the misty sky dry to the touch first. A hair dryer on low speeds it up.
Rinse the brush fully first: this is the lightest paint yet.
Inside the outlined area. Its top is about 1 1/4 in from the top edge, and its left side is at the left edge; it's about 1 1/4 in wide and 2 in tall.
The outline also runs under where the birches' shading and bark patches, and the autumn leaves will go: paint straight through there.
The outline also reaches onto the misty sky, painted already: there, only soften this paint into its edge and leave it showing.
Paint: Sun cream.
Brush: #8 round.
Small circles with the tip of the brush make a bumpy edge. Around a bright spot, circular strokes move outward from it.
It should leave a bumpy, soft edge.
Watch out: The edge is too hard. Fix: soften it with lighter passes. Smudging with a finger works too.
Step back, squint, or take a photo to see it whole, and compare the big shapes with the picture.

steps.meant: A soft cream sun glows in the upper left with a bumpy soft edge. The rest of the canvas is still only the misty haze.
